parameters.content:
## Process one invoice
Called by **1 Intake** once per PDF, so every invoice gets its own execution and its own callback URL.

1. Submit the PDF to **OpsCore** `/v1/jobs` and wait for the signed callback (HMAC-SHA256 over `timestamp.body`, 5 min freshness).
2. Route: **auto-approve** (OpsCore `done`, confidence >= 0.85, totals valid) · **Slack review** (`needs_review`) · **duplicate** (OpsCore or ledger match) · **failed**.
3. Store in Postgres `finance.*`, append to the **Northwind Ledger** sheet, embed for the Q&A agent, post a summary.

parameters.jsCode:
// The Crypto node returns only JSON; put the PDF back for the upload.
return [{ json: $json, binary: $('From intake').first().binary }];

parameters.query:
-- Second duplicate check (OpsCore already compares vendor + number + total) and vendor history for anomaly flags.
with p as (select $1::jsonb as j)
select
  (select i.job_id from finance.invoices i, p
    where regexp_replace(lower(i.vendor), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = regexp_replace(lower(p.j->>'vendor'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g')
      and regexp_replace(upper(i.invoice_no), '[^0-9A-Z]', '', 'g') = regexp_replace(upper(p.j->>'invoice_no'), '[^0-9A-Z]', '', 'g')
    order by i.created_at limit 1) as ledger_duplicate_of,
  (select count(*) from finance.invoices i, p where lower(i.vendor) = lower(p.j->>'vendor') and i.currency = p.j->>'currency') as vendor_invoice_count,
  (select round(avg(i.total), 2) from finance.invoices i, p where lower(i.vendor) = lower(p.j->>'vendor') and i.currency = p.j->>'currency') as vendor_avg_total

nodes.name: Send review to OpsCore
nodes.notes: Stores the human-checked data in OpsCore as eval ground truth. A failure here does not block the ledger.

// The HTTP node replaced the item with OpsCore's answer; carry the invoice forward and keep the answer.
return [{ json: { ...$('Apply decision').first().json, opscore_review: $json.status || $json.error || null } }];

parameters.query:
-- One statement: invoice + line items + the intake outcome, so a failure leaves nothing half-written.
with p as (select $1::jsonb as j),
inv as (
  insert into finance.invoices (job_id, invoice_no, vendor, invoice_date, due_date, currency, subtotal, tax, total,
                                status, confidence, approved_by, source, source_email)
  select j->>'job_id', j->>'invoice_no', j->>'vendor', (j->>'invoice_date')::date, (j->>'due_date')::date, j->>'currency',
         (j->>'subtotal')::numeric, (j->>'tax')::numeric, (j->>'total')::numeric,
         j->>'status', (j->>'confidence')::numeric, j->>'approved_by', j->>'source', j->>'source_email'
  from p
  returning id
),
li as (
  insert into finance.line_items (invoice_id, line_no, description, qty, unit_price, amount)
  select inv.id, l.ord, l.x->>'description', (l.x->>'qty')::numeric, (l.x->>'unit_price')::numeric, (l.x->>'amount')::numeric
  from inv, p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j->'line_items') with ordinality as l(x, ord)
  returning 1
),
ev as (
  insert into finance.intake_events (job_id, file_sha256, file_name, source, outcome, detail)
  select j->>'job_id', j->>'file_sha256', j->>'file_name', j->>'source', 'stored',
         jsonb_build_object('status', j->>'status', 'confidence', j->'confidence', 'anomalies', j->'anomalies', 'edits', j->'edits')
  from p
  returning 1
)
select (select id from inv) as invoice_id, (select count(*) from li) as line_items_stored

insert into finance.intake_events (job_id, file_sha256, file_name, source, outcome, detail)
select j->>'job_id', j->>'file_sha256', j->>'file_name', j->>'source', j->>'outcome',
       jsonb_build_object('detail', j->>'detail', 'duplicate_of', j->>'duplicate_of', 'invoice_no', j->>'invoice_no', 'vendor', j->>'vendor')
from (select $1::jsonb as j) p
returning id
